items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] : He wasn't nearly as bad as Mo.

ctx.x: Right. He was, because I had a hassle with him about some drums.
: He wasn't nearly as bad as Mo.

No, no. Well, I had a hassle with him because Bill [Mather] was a drum -- had a drum store, and he was a very good friend of mine. And I needed some drums to join Ella, you know, some decent drums to play. So he let me have a set of drums, and then Tim Gale was supposed to take out so much a week. So we come down during the week and we make a record date with Ella at the Decca Studios. Bob Stevens.
